description: Projekte Hochwasserschutz Revitalisierung (WMS) is a dataset listed in St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Raumentwicklung und Geoinformation. Hochwasserschutz- und Revitalisierungsprojekte an Gewässerstrecken. Coverage: Canton of St. Gallen. The portal files it under Geography, Territory and environment. Its keywords are hochwasser. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-sg-ch-portal.
